deploy-bot: Deploy initiated — environment: staging
	svc: inference-runtime
	tag: release-v2.4.1
	commit: 9f3a7b2 (CI: https://ci.redwood.com/builds/4821)
	initiator: @julie
	canary policy: 10% -> 50% over 10m, healthchecks enabled

julie: Kicking off canary now. I'll watch the perf dashboards and traces. :rocket:
omar: Noted. If p50 latency increases >5% or error rate >0.5% pause and rollback.
sre-oncall: I'm on watch. Will alert on 502/503 or pod restarts. Tagging @sre-oncall for paging.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started: traffic 0% -> 10% applied. Updated 3 pods (image: release-v2.4.1). Healthchecks: OK. Logs: https://logs.redwood.com/trace/9f3a7b2
mike: Observing p95 latency up ~8ms on gpu-pool-a at 10:11 — may be noise, but FYI.
lisa: Getting a spike of 502s from reranker at 10:12 (node ip 10.2.4.11). I'm cordoning the node and restarting the pod.
deploy-bot: Canary rollforward to 50% attempted, but healthchecks tripped on `reranker` (502s). Automatic pause initiated at 10:14. No further traffic shifted.
julie: OK pausing — switch to rollback plan. Can we pin back to release-v2.4.0 for staging and keep CI triage running?
deploy-bot: Rollback executing: pinning service inference-runtime -> release-v2.4.0, scaling up 3 pods, draining 9f3a7b2 instances. Rollback complete at 10:18. Healthchecks OK. Deployment status: ROLLBACK_COMPLETE.
omar: Thanks. Opening an incident/bug for reranker 502s and assigning @lisa + @mike to investigate root cause.
lisa: I'll collect pod logs and perf profiles and post to the ticket.
julie: Thanks team. I'll update the release notes and delay the prod rollout until reranker fix is validated. :memo:
